public: On 21 December 2022, the Council adopted draft S/2022/980 as resolution 2669 (2022), 12–0–3. China, India and Russia abstained. The United Kingdom voted in favour.

assertions.uk-position: The United Kingdom sponsored the draft and stressed ending violence and enabling aid after Council, ASEAN and regional consultations.
assertions.india-position: India advocated quiet, constructive diplomacy and cited neighbours’ concerns.
assertions.chair-role: India’s Council President announced adoption. India’s representative separately explained its national abstention.
assertions.humanitarian-terms: The resolution demands an immediate end to violence and calls for humanitarian access.
assertions.oral-report: Recognizing ASEAN’s central role, the Council requested an oral report by 15 March 2023 to the Council from the Secretary-General or his Special Envoy in coordination with the ASEAN Special Envoy, on UN support for the Five-Point Consensus.

shared: Both took regional perspectives into account. The United Kingdom supported adoption, while India abstained.
